proposals.evidence: Turner’s first *chōkara branch gives Hindi chorā/chorī, Gujarati chorɔ/chorī/chorũ and the addendum’s Kiunthali ċhoru child/boy. These western child/son/daughter and boy/girl forms match that r-family, with regional s/ṣ/ś/ts realization and vowel raising retained. They are kept distinct from the retained-k chokr- branch and the different orphan entry *chōra.
